messages.text: I’m checking whether a thicker annulus can recover the original plate and LAr-gap sampling while keeping the compact inner radius. This screen is conditional on allowing the outer-to-inner radius ratio to change.

**LAR-COMPACT-CALOTECH-THICKER-SCREEN**, pinned **5a8814fc1947b16446aa0c9e3c73714ad06837b7**. Read-only; **no files changed, native execution or transport**.

**Correction:** my earlier transition warning omitted the `cosh(η)` increase in physical path length. Its “15–17 X₀” estimate was wrong and is superseded by the truncated-chord calculation below. **No sampling-depth shortfall appeared in the completed finite handover screen.**

The strongest conditional option is:

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---:|
| Warm bore / sampling inner radius | 1700 / 1772.8 mm |
| Inclination | 50.18° |
| Periods | **1248** |
| Pb / steel / glue / electrode | **1.8 / 0.2 / 0.1 / 1.2 mm** |
| Sampling outer radius | **2350 mm** |
| Inner single LAr gaps | **1.20665 / 1.20894 mm** |
| Outer single LAr gaps | **3.16903 / 3.17390 mm** |
| Warm outer radius, retaining 210 mm rear bath | **2641.7 mm** |
| Logical barrel channels | **1,979,328** |

This restores approximately the original inner gap and lead/electrode thicknesses. It changes `Rout/Rin` from **1.186626 to 1.325587**, so remains conditional on the user permitting that change.

Preserve the original **normalized radial compartment fractions**:

`f_i = (R_i_old − Rin_old)/(Rout_old − Rin_old)`

Set `R_i_new = 1772.8 + (2350 − 1772.8) f_i`, then convert to electrode path coordinates:

`t_i = −Rin cos α + sqrt(R_i_new² − Rin² sin² α)`.

The builder uses successive differences of `t_i`. This construction passed with partition residual **−3.82×10⁻¹⁴**.

**Central phase screen:** 128 phases gave estimated sampling **26.804–27.318 X₀**, active-LAr chords **324.65–327.31 mm**, and 106–110 sensitive path segments. Segments are not independent shower layers.

Alternative screens:

| Periods / outer sampling radius | Minimum estimated X₀ |
|---|---:|
| 1248 / 2325 mm | 25.920 — below the 26 target |
| 1248 / 2340 mm | 26.352 |
| 1280 / 2325 mm | 26.495; inner gap approximately 1.136 mm |

All estimates use declared approximate material radiation lengths in mm: **Pb 5.612, LAr 140, steel 17.5, glue 180, PCB 180**. Native material lengths must replace them.

**Corrected handover screen:** combined the axially truncated barrel chords, multiplied by `cosh(η)`, with exact inclined endcap-piece intersections for the retained **650 mm** endcaps at sampling `z=5210–5860 mm`. Twenty η values spanning **1.2–1.6**, including exact envelope-entry/exit angles, were tested with **64 phase probes per η**, sweeping the actual 1248/384/720/1360 periods.

| |η| | Minimum combined sampling X₀ |
|---|---:|
| 1.35 | 39.725 |
| 1.382704, first endcap-envelope entry | 33.387 |
| 1.40 | 35.071 |
| 1.45 | 38.592 |
| 1.50 | 38.033 |
| 1.525 | 31.931 |
| 1.60 | 31.381 |

The finite handover minimum was **31.381 X₀**. This supersedes the earlier rough warning; it does not prove a continuous angular minimum or qualify upstream dead-material effects.

**Radial service implications:** with existing three-bank offsets, board-bank fronts become **2365/2410/2455 mm**, N₂ pipe centre **2547 mm**, and bath back **2560 mm**. The existing 1000 mm front reservation exceeds the inherited two-arc bound of **854.08 mm** for the 100 mm jacket with 400 mm bends. HCAL front 3130 mm leaves **488.3 mm** beyond the barrel warm wall. Ports, supports and actual routing still require native/interface checks.

The canonical φ cell span changes to `2π/624 ≈ 0.01007 rad`; its inner physical pitch remains approximately **17.85 mm**, close to the original **17.78 mm**. Outer gaps and angular granularity change, so depth calibration and a new matched 10k comparison remain necessary. **No precision-preservation claim follows from this screen.**
